title: 51:11 redeemed . . . return . . . with singing. Those who will "return, and come with singing unto Zion" are the Latter-day Saints. Joseph Smith admonished us to work "diligently, spiritually and temporally for the redemption of Zion, that the pure in heart may return with songs of everlasting joy to build up her waste places, and meet the Lord when he comes in his glory." 20
author: Tina M. Peterson
